accessRights: REPLACE with one of: INTERNAL, OPEN, COMMERCIAL

contactPoint.contactName: REPLACE with a team or role name
contactPoint.email: REPLACE with a team mailbox, never a personal one

creator: REPLACE: The business entity responsible for creating or compiling the original content of an information resource.
description: REPLACE: A concise narrative of the content of an information resource.
identifier: REPLACE: A unique number, code, or reference value assigned to an information resource within a given context.
licence: REPLACE: Reference to the legal document outlining access and usage rights for an information resource.
modified: REPLACE: The date, or date and time, on which the content of an information resource is changed.
publisher: REPLACE: The business entity responsible for making an information resource publicly available.
securityClassification: REPLACE with one of: OFFICIAL, SECRET, TOP_SECRET, NOT_APPLICABLE
title: REPLACE: The full and formal name given to an information resource.
type: REPLACE: The type of the resource being defined
version: REPLACE: The version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
updateFrequency: REPLACE with one of: freq:triennial, freq:biennial, freq:annual, freq:semiannual, freq:threeTimesAYear, freq:quarterly, freq:bimonthly, freq:monthly, freq:semimonthly, freq:biweekly, freq:threeTimesAMonth, freq:weekly, freq:semiweekly, freq:threeTimesAWeek, freq:daily, freq:continuous, freq:irregular
